learning_objective: Position the lap and shoulder straps safely during pregnancy.
scenario: Pregnant passenger, no exemption, before departure. Determine correct routing of both seat-belt straps.

fr.question_text: Enceinte et sans dispense médicale, je m’installe comme passagère. Comment positionner correctement ma ceinture ?
fr.answer_a: La sangle basse sous le ventre, au plus bas sur le bassin.
fr.answer_b: La sangle basse au milieu du ventre.
fr.answer_c: La sangle diagonale sur l’épaule et le thorax.
fr.answer_d: La sangle diagonale derrière mon dos.
fr.explanation: Pendant la grossesse, la sangle basse doit passer sous le ventre, au plus bas sur les os du bassin. La partie diagonale reste sur l’épaule et le thorax : la placer derrière le dos supprime une partie de la protection.

en.question_text: I am pregnant and have no medical exemption. I am getting into the passenger seat. How should I position my seat belt?
en.answer_a: The lap strap below my abdomen, as low as possible on my pelvis.
en.answer_b: The lap strap across the middle of my abdomen.
en.answer_c: The diagonal strap over my shoulder and chest.
en.answer_d: The diagonal strap behind my back.
en.explanation: During pregnancy, the lap strap should pass below the abdomen, as low as possible over the pelvic bones. The diagonal strap stays over the shoulder and chest; putting it behind the back removes part of the protection.

fr.a: La sangle prend appui sur le bassin, sous le ventre.
fr.b: Le ventre ne doit pas supporter la sangle basse.
fr.c: La partie haute conserve son trajet normal.
fr.d: Derrière le dos, elle ne retient plus correctement le thorax.

en.a: The lap strap rests on the pelvis below the abdomen.
en.b: The lap strap must not run across the abdomen.
en.c: The upper strap keeps its normal route.
en.d: Behind the back it cannot properly restrain the chest.

sources.supports: Interior Ministry31May2024 En cas de grossesse: lap strap below abdomen, lowest possible on pelvic bone; upper part positioned normally. Current page read10October2026.
